# Pourcast

> A free pour-over coffee brew timer that paces every pour in real time — not just a ratio calculator. Guided recipes for popular drippers, usable with or without a scale.

Pourcast is a web app (also shipped as an iOS app) for brewing pour-over coffee. You pick a brewer and dose — or fine-tune a full recipe — and Pourcast runs a live, guided brew timer that tells you exactly how much water to pour and when: bloom, pours, swirls, and drawdown, paced step by step in real time. It works fully offline and needs no scale, though it can connect to a Bluetooth coffee scale for live weight where the browser supports it.

## Features
- Real-time guided brew timer: bloom → pours → drawdown, each step paced with a countdown
- Coffee-to-water ratio calculator (enter cups or grams; the other adjusts automatically)
- Recipes for Hario V60, Kalita Wave, Chemex, Origami, Melitta, AeroPress, French press, and Phin
- Two modes: "Just Brew" (we set the ratio and pace) and "Brew Print" (fine-tune method, grind, and temperature)
- Optional Bluetooth scale support for live weight (desktop Chrome/Edge and Android Chrome; iOS uses guided timers)
- Four visual themes; works fully offline
